title: Voice: one assistant places each sentence as you talk

chat.text: One plain voice assistant replaces the fast assistant. Each Whisper sentence lands in place in the chat bubble, and the assistant places it: same paragraph (default), its own paragraph, or its own card. Plan first at /framework/ux/Dictate/doc/voice-assistant.md, then the smallest working slice.

add.title: Plan written, slices built, in review
add.text: The plan: [voice-assistant.md](/framework/ux/Dictate/doc/voice-assistant.md). Built in a worktree: the voice-assistant role and skill; your words now settle in place in the bubble (no draft bubble, no faded copy); the chat applies placements (same paragraph, own paragraph, own card). Headless proof passes at 400 and 1200. Next: review, merge, then Servex wiring (needs a restart).

add.title: Landed: sentences stay in place, placements are drawn
add.text: Merged (795da9d9e), review passed. Your words now grow inside the chat bubble and stay put when sent. A `{place}` line from the item tool keeps a sentence in the same paragraph, starts a new one, or makes it a titled card. Proof: `ux/Dictate/test/in-place.mjs`, fake mic, all checks pass at 400 and 1200. Plan: [voice-assistant.md](/framework/ux/Dictate/doc/voice-assistant.md). Still to do: Sessions.js wakes the voice assistant (queued in [todo](/framework/ai/todo.md); needs a Servex restart).

message.text:
helper-voice-assistant-wake: The `Sessions.js` change is merged into `michael/dev` (merge commit `fec3403da`) but not live. It stays off until Servex restarts with `SERVEX_SESSION_ASSISTANT=voice`. I did not restart it, and `needs_restart` is logged in the task.

- **Tests:** `Sessions.test.mjs` passes all 21 checks, six of them new.
- **Proof:** a private Servex with three sentences wrote three `{place}` lines, and every `re` was an owner line's `at`. They came from `voice-assistant-v-5orl4a2`, and it wrote no chat reply. The first run printed FAIL because my own check counted the smart assistant's three chat answers as

Live since the 01:00 restart: the voice assistant is the default seat in every dictation session. Each sentence you finish wakes it with the whole prompt so far, and it writes one placement line (same paragraph by default, own paragraph, or own card) through the item tool; it writes no chat reply. The fast assistant is kept as the escape hatch: write the word fast into session-assistant.txt in the Servex home folder and restart Servex. Plan and the switch: /framework/ux/Dictate/doc/voice-assistant.md. Still open from your words: raw transcript lines swallowed into a forming summary (a queued brief), and in-place transcription on the phone sheet.
Started: raw Whisper lines will look raw, and a summary line folds a card's raw lines under it with a toggle. Working in worktree voice-swallow.

Landed: unrefined Whisper lines now look raw (muted monospace) in the Dictate chat, and a card's summary line folds its lines under a "N raw lines" toggle, live, nothing deleted. Proof at 400 and 1200 passes; Servex needs a restart for the voice assistant to know the new summary verb.

helper-voice-swallow: The swallow task has landed (merge `aa6109df8`), and I'm not working on anything now. The proof passes at 400 and 1200, and the details are in the "Raw and refined" section of `voice-assistant.md`.

Servex needs a restart before the voice assistant knows the new `summary` verb. I haven't restarted it, and I logged that in my own task log.

The phone sheet thread no longer pushes older lines while you read: with the fake mic at 400 wide, five sentences gave 0 moves of older bubbles in split (it was 27–38), and 0 moves when the reader had scrolled up first. The newest bubble now turns a page only when it runs out of room, and a reader who scrolled up is never moved. Rule and alternatives: /framework/ux/Dictate/doc/voice-assistant.md ("Nothing jumps"); proof: ux/Dictate/test/anchor.mjs.
